numbers: 寒假六周；2 月 13（前章）；Crescent 1886 落成

facts.fact: 她留紧急字条在 outbox「来见我」；没打断上课；压下棱角；好久没想为谁努力
做草稿如追蛛网丝——越推越觉结构会塌；仍追
facts.anchor: following the strands of a spiderweb
facts.verbatim: following the strands of a spiderweb

facts.fact: 她没看医生；脚渐好、每誊一页更稳——也许伤有心理成分
Harriot 数小时后到、被风吹乱；「今天有警察在这晃」；她说大概学生抽大麻
facts.anchor: There’s police walking around here today.
facts.verbatim: There’s police walking around here today.

facts.fact: 她提暑假看管人：六周、路险、别人清场——「如果你没处去…」
facts.anchor: I usually take on the role of campus caretaker
facts.verbatim: I usually take on the role of campus caretaker

facts.fact: Harriot 一闪穿房吻她（响亮喜剧的 smack）；「Darling girl！你解决一切。我当然留下！」
facts.anchor: You’ve solved everything. Of course I’ll stay!
facts.verbatim: You’ve solved everything. Of course I’ll stay!

facts.fact: 她请求搬来同住；Celia 答应「随你」；她欢腾：几个电话、东西送来、车库放车
facts.anchor: Can I move in with you?
facts.verbatim: Can I move in with you?

facts.fact: Eureka Springs 如雪球美景；Crescent 酒店（1886 你抵达时刚落成）
facts.anchor: just being completed when you arrived on the railway in 1886
facts.verbatim: just being completed when you arrived on the railway in 1886

facts.fact: 「Beatrice 开幕之夜来过这儿」；炉壁铭文（夏日/秋叶/雪盖大地→炽热恋人）；「看《闪灵》吗？」
facts.anchor: Then you will be my ardent lover.
facts.verbatim: Then you will be my ardent lover.

facts.fact: 电梯边见 Jonathan（眼镜闪光、两男同上、门合前认出他的颌线）；忠诚按住舌「没什么」
facts.anchor: I recognized the curve of a familiar jaw
facts.verbatim: I recognized the curve of a familiar jaw

facts.fact: 酒吧：敬项目/合作/孤独；她掏出两周来写的页（像奖赏）；Celia 读得嫉妒暗燃——「她又一次变成了你」
facts.anchor: returned to me in Harriot’s hand
facts.verbatim: returned to me in Harriot’s hand

facts.fact: 「很好。我知道我会有修改」；她说「明天大家都走——等只剩我们能再试地图吗？」；雪只是阵雪；她慢慢摇头=yes
facts.anchor: For the research, my eyes cajoled.
facts.verbatim: For the research, my eyes cajoled.
